description: argc less than 1 is outside the clasp_parseArguments contract.

expected.note: clasp_parseArguments behaviour is undefined when argc is less than 1.

notes: No result is invented. A port that defines empty-argv behaviour still does not satisfy this case; the C contract is undefined.

provenance.note: Compared with CLASP 0.16.0.67 (CLASP_VER = 0x00100043) at revision 0afd4611372a94b6441e593ef57fa8d4b1306c65. The header says behaviour is undefined if argc is less than 1.
